text:
kevin: heads-up: argonaut-7b-int4 embedding run finished. want routing/ops recs for search/semantic-index workloads

anya: nice. top-line numbers?

kevin: embedding dim 1024, embed-throughput ~1.6k reqs/s on n1-medium pool, p99 latency 82ms. est cost for online embedgen $0.0021 per 1k tokens (approx per request $0.00003). baseline fp16 (argonaut-7b-fp16) throughput 900 reqs/s, p99 140ms, est cost $0.0058 per 1k tokens

leila: wow cost delta is huge (~64% cheaper). what about retrieval quality?

kevin: ran standard search MRR@10 on GTN-retrieval bench (10k queries): int4 MRR 0.382 vs fp16 0.401 => delta -0.019 absolute (~4.7% relative). recall@100 down 1.3% absolute. cosine drift observed on tail queries (named entities, code snippets)

matt: 4.7% MRR loss might be noticeable for relevance-sensitive products. where do failures concentrate?

kevin: majority in low-frequency entity queries and short queries with numeric tokens. embedding norm variance slightly higher for int4 -> increases nearest-neighbor noise. also saw slightly worse clustering for incremental index adds

index-bot: index-sanity-check: int4 embeddings + HNSW insert latency up 12% on batch-updates; index recall snapshot taken at ts=3311111100

anya: ops proposal: two-tier embedding strategy: 1) offline/periodic full-index rebuilds use fp16 to ensure anchor quality 2) live/ephemeral query-time embeddings use int4 for cost savings, with hybrid fallback for flagged high-value queries (billing/legal/search-internal) to fp16

leila: how to detect flagged high-value queries? product tags exist for ~25% traffic. suggestion: start with rule-based mapping (endpoint id, product flag) + heuristic for short queries with entity patterns. we can train a small classifier later with product-labeled data

matt: alternative: always compute int4 for query, but when top-k score spread < threshold (i.e., ambiguous result) re-embed with fp16 for re-rerank (cheap for small k). saves cost and only pays extra for ambiguous cases

anya: both ideas useful. combine them: route flagged high-value queries to fp16 immediately; otherwise do int4 then conditional fp16 re-rerank if score_gap < 0.08 (threshold to tune)

kevin: ops constraints: CV memory for fp16 workers limited, but re-rerank on k=5 is cheap. need to add instrumentation: score_gap metric, fallback-rate, re-rerank-latency, quality-delta sampled per-slice

index-bot: monitoring hooks requested: register metrics embed_variant, top1_score, top5_score_gap, re-rerank_count, p99_query_latency_by_variant

leila: product/GTN ask: scorecard CSV with slices: short_query_entity, short_query_generic, long_query_paragraph, code_snippet, ecommerce_product, billing_query. columns: sample_n, fp16_MRR, int4_MRR, delta_abs, delta_pct, median_latency_fp16, median_latency_int4, est_cost_fp16_per_1k, est_cost_int4_per_1k, recommended_routing

matt: include a small ROI calc for a mid-size customer: 100M queries/month -> estimate monthly cost delta and estimated impact on clicks (use MRR->CTR proxy). helps PMs choose price buckets

anya: ops rollout plan: 1) shadow-mode int4 for 7 days across 50% traffic to collect score_gap distrib 2) implement two-tier routing hooks + re-rerank logic 3) start 20% live int4 for non-flagged queries with conditional fp16 re-rerank 4) monitor 14 days, expand if stable

kevin: caveat: int4 index-insert behavior needs testing. recommend delaying live incremental index writes from int4 clients for 48h while we validate HNSW stability

leila: messaging for GTN: "New cost-optimized embedding tier — up to 60% lower inference cost for embeddings. We recommend the fidelity tier (fp16) for legal, billing, and high-value search flows; hybrid mode provides best of both worlds." include sample worst-case QA diffs and suggested warnings for index maintainers

matt: security note: make sure re-rerank fallback does not leak any additional user PII to a different cluster; keep routing within same VPC/customer boundary

kevin: will prepare CSV + sample diffs and attach S3 link (redacted) tomorrow. please add monitoring alerts: MRR_delta > 1.5% for any slice OR re-rerank_rate > 5%

anya: agreed. ops: create flags argonaut-emb-int4-canary and argonaut-emb-fallback, add dashboards (per-slice MRR, cost-per-M queries, fallback-rate, score_gap histogram)

index-bot: flags created: argonaut-emb-int4-canary, argonaut-emb-fallback. baseline snapshots saved.

leila: timeline: kevin posts CSV EOD; ops implements flags and monitoring by Fri; start shadowing Mon; review after 7 days then start 20% live conditional re-rerank rollout.

matt: thanks all. great pragmatic plan. :thumbsup:
